preconditions.description: The number of participants m and the number of top results n must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= points[i] <= 2 * m for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each of the n integers representing points must be non-negative and not exceed 2*m.
The length of the points list must be exactly n.

postconditions.description: Output 'no' if no valid tournament exists, otherwise output 'yes' followed by the tournament table.

postconditions.expression: all(tournament_table[i][j] in 'XWDL' for i in range(m) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each character in the tournament table must be one of 'X', 'W', 'D', or 'L'.
The main diagonal of the tournament table must consist of 'X' characters.
